transformation: Exact unique prompt-text join; SHA-256 prompt/response hashes replace raw text; duration ns converted to seconds; no replay, model fitting, or warm selection. All matched pairs retained. Raw source row ordinals are zero based.

laptop2.cpu: Intel i7 10th Gen, listed 12-core at 2.7 GHz

workstation.cpu: Intel Xeon W-2223, listed 8-core at 3.6 GHz

reported_software: Ollama, model label gemma:7b; exact engine version, checkpoint digest, quantization and offload settings unavailable in CSV/paper
energy_units: kWh: GPU board energy, CPU LLM process estimate, their total; not facility energy and not demonstrably incremental above idle
duration_units: Source total/load/prompt/response durations are Ollama ns; extracted columns seconds. start/end timestamps timezone UTC. clock_duration calculated from start/end.
historical_code_caveat: Last published repository revision by 2024-07-05, not proven exact code used for each May measurement. Default integration buffers .5 s before and .5 s after request. CPU filter ollamaserve may omit runner subprocesses; actual collection version unrecorded.
